tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (537)༄༅/ /bstan srung gtso mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bka' brgyud bstan pa'i ba dan ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /
(537)༄༅/ /bstan srung gtso mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bka' brgyud bstan pa'i ba dan ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (537)༄༅// bstan srung gtso mo 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bka' brgyud bstan pa'i ba dan ces bya ba bzhugs so//

(538)༄༅// na mo gu ru badz+ra dha rā ya/ sher phyin yum gyi phrin las rtsal// bstan srung gtso mo'i skur snang ba// 'dod khams dbang phyug dud sol mas// bstan pa rgyas pa'i dge legs rtsol// mnga' bdag mar pa'i bstan srung brgya rtsa brgyad las khyad par du 'phags pa dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma'i rjes gnang bya ba la gsum/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o// dang po ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi la 'brub khung gru gsum nag po bya/ de'i dbus thod skam gyi rwa ba zlum po'i nang du gru gsum mthing nag zur gsum du rdo rje phyed bas mtshan pa bris ba'i dbus su nas nag gis tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i mdun tu khri'u'i khar zangs lcags kyi snod du/ ra nag dang bya nag gtso bor gyur pa'i sha khrag sna tshogs pas sbrags pa'i gtor ma thod mkhar ma'am kha ṭ+wāṃ ma gang rung bcas la bsham/ me tog /spos/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ mar me lnga po go rim ltar bkod/ 'bul gtor zur pa sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'du bya'o// gnyis pa la thog mar sgrub mchod ni/ bdag bskyed rngog lugs dgyes rdor rgyas bsdus gang rung grub na legs/ gzhan yang bde mchog mā yā gdan bzhi lta bu mar pa'i bka' brgyud las byon pa zhig gi rnal 'byor la gnas dgos shing*/ de dag kyang rgyas par mi nus na dran pa (539)gcig pa'i bzlas sgom tsam gyis 'thus so// de nas mdun bskyed mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsang gtor/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams rang bzhin stong pa/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed nus par gyur/

oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ nī ri ti hūm̐ kha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin tu sbyar te/ dhū pe/ gan+dhe/ nai wid+ya/ ā lo ke /rnam dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi tā/ sogs kyis rol mo'i byin dbab/ mdun tu skad cig gis lha mo dud sol ma bzhugs pa'i snying gar/ oṃ dkar po la gnas pa'i ra yig dmar po/ ra las me 'od 'phro bas/ sku lus skad cig gis bsregs/ (540)oṃ de'i steng du baṃ yongs su gyur pa las bum pa dkar po bdud rtsis gang ba/ de las bdud rtsi lud de/ oṃ bkrus pas 'od zer dkar po rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ aṃ ma hā ka li/ de wi ka ra li/ bi kran+ta tsaṇ+ḍa nu pi ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa// de nyid skad cig gis dpal ldan lha mo'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog nag mo// keng rus ltar skem pa'i lus can/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis pa/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa ni bañdza dmar chen gyis bskyil ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na shak+ti/ gnyis pa na tri shu la dar dpyangs can 'dzin pa/ mi ro rengs mkhar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ral pa dmar ser gyen brdzes lan bu g.yon du 'khyil ba/ sbrul dang thod phreng gis brgyan pa snyan g.yas na dri bu'i mgul rgyan can gyi sbrul dang*/ g.yon na seng ges brgyan pa/ me tog dang dar nag gcod pan can/ lha ma yin gyis mgo bos do shal byas pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing*/ ba glang gi pags pa re lde ser po'i sham bu can gyis smad dkris pa la/ klu'i rgyal po bshibs pas ske rags byas pa/ lcags sgrog gis brgyan pa'i zhabs gnyis bong bu gwa pa'i steng na btsan bskyil gyis bzhugs pa/ dur khrod gyi dbus na sgra drag po sgrog cing*/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sdes bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar thugs kyi ye shes mar me ltar 'bar ba sgo nga'i dbyibs can sor bzhi pa/

de'i dbus su hūm̐/ mtha' skor du oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya/ de wī ka li ma hā ka li hūm̐ bh+yoḥ zhes pas bskor bar gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ gcig chad de bha gar thim/ badz+ra lā s+ya rā ga ya mi/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i lha mo dpal (541)nag mo 'bum sde dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bh+yoḥ ri rab chen po'i byang shar mtshams// g.yu mtsho mu le gting gi dbus// rin chen lnga ldan gzhal yas khang*// de dbus srid gsum thod mkhar dbus// gru gsum 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// dpal ldan lha mo dung sol ma// sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i gzugs// zhal gcig phyag bzhi bong bu chibs// 'khor yang ma mo 'bum sde'i tshogs// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// da lta snyigs ma'i dus nyid du// dam can gshegs par mi 'os kyang*// sngon tshe byang chub shing drung du// thub pa chen po'i spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// 'gro kun bde la 'god pa'i phyir// dpal ldan lho mo gshegs su gsol// gsang sngags srung ma dam tshig can// 'khor bcas gshegs shing bzhugs su gsol/ /ces spyan drangs/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wi ka li ka li ma hā ka li hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma hoḥ zhes pas gnyis su med par thim/ 'khor nag mo 'bum sde thams cad kyang gcer bu ral pa can/ g.yas mi snying dang*/ g.yon ban+dha skra can thogs pa'o// thams cad kyi thugs kar yang bh+yo yig gis mtshan pa/ dud pa'i sol ba ma khyod kyi sku myur du ston cig /sku mi ston na yang yid la gang 'dod thams cad grub par gyis shig /nang mchod gtor la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis (542)'grub/

oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma naṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dam la bzhag /oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya sogs snying po'i mthar/ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ ā lo ke /zhes sbyar/ gtor ma'i nang du ha ser po ho dkar po hrīḥsngon po de rnams kyi 'od kyis kha dog dri ro ngan pa bcom ste/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥswā hā/ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ hūm̐ sogs kyis mthar/ oṃ ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ i daṃ bā liṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa pā ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul bas 'khor dang bcas pas gsol bar bsam/ bstod pa rgyas pa spro na bram ze mchog sreg kyis mdzad pa ni/ bh+yoḥ til mar gyis bskus lan bu gcig 'phyangs ro nye'i rna chas sgeg cing cha lugs ma lus 'tshang*/ rgyan du rkang sgrog lcags las byas pa gcig gis rang gi rkang pa mdzes par byas pa ste/ gcer bu bong bu zhon nas 'gro ba 'di na rgyu ba de ni lha khyod yin te/ bdag gi mdzes par shes kyis gzhan ltas khyod kyi spyod pa'i mtshan chen don dag su yis shes/ 'khor ba'i 'jig pa'i tshe na mi lus dag las khrag dang zhag 'dzag dud pa 'thul ba na/ lha mo mche ba mi bzad gtsigs pa khyod kyi zhal du 'gro kun skad cig tsam gyis zhugs par 'gyur/ nag mo mi thod thogs pa khyod ni rnal 'byor bsgrub pa'i spyod yul can de dur khrod dgyes/ khyod ni g.yon can mnan cing nad dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sel zhing mi zad dril yang sgrog /khyod ni dpa' bo dag gi mgo ni cod pan legs spras g.yul du mtshon gyis bsad pa yi// phreng ba thogs shing gar byed lag pa mnyen rkyang rkub chos che shing klu dbang gshibs pa yi/ ska rags (543)'ching zhing lag na mdung dang ral gri thogs shing khrag gi chang gis myos gyur bas// mig rtsa dmar mor gyur cing mtshan mo dur khrod rgyu ba 'byung po phal cher rnams kyis mthong*// ko rlon chen po dral te rgyangs pa'i gos kyis na bza' stod g.yogs smad ni re lde ser pos dkris// mi yi rgyu ma gsar pa'i sbubs kyis zhal gyi zla ba brgyan cing dril bu 'gram par 'khrol// lus ni snum gyis gsar du byugs shing khrag dang zhag mang 'dzag pa'i thig les tshom bu bris// mi yi sha la so yis chom chem gcod byed thod pa can des bdag la skyong gyur cig

/drag po drag mo mi bzad mi khan thogs pa sngon chad ma byung khyod mthong nas// ma mo rnams kyang skrag cing rtabs la rngam pa 'don cing mig rtsa rig rig khyod la 'dud// nag mo bzang mo lus mdog nag cing bzod par dka' ba khyod la brgya byin la sogs kyang*// nyin gcig bzhin tu bstod par byed cing gshin rje'i rgyal po nyid kyang 'dar zhing 'du bar byed// mi rnams dang ni 'gro ba ma lus 'jug brtul bas na khyod kyi rnam pa ya gcig la// brang gi 'gro ba'i gdeng ka stong dang ldan pa gcig gi rgyab nas khyod la rgyan du byas// ya gcig la ni seng ge mtshungs med 'phyang zhing rgya mtsho'i mtha' bskor sa gzhi ma lus gnon// steng nas 'byung ba'i nyi ma 'od zer stong ldan de ni khyod kyi lte ba'i phyogs su bzhag /bh+yoḥ rgya mtsho'i klong nas me 'bar khyod// mtsho rnams skem par nus ma ste// bud med thams cad zhi mdzad phyir// lha chen sku yi phyed du bzhag /rdzong dang bka' zlog nag mo che// lha dang lha min phyag byas ma// mi nad gang yin khyod mi shes// de la 'jigs pa med par 'gyur// gshin rje'i lcam mo bdud kyi (544)yum// 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba yi// dpal ldan lha mo khyod la bstod/ /bsdu na/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rang don sgrub phyir rnam thar la gzhol yang*/ snying rje'i dbang gis rjes la thob pa yi// shes rab sna tshogs dag gis 'gro don mdzad// lho phyogs gshin rje'i pho brang rtag tu gnas// khams gsum skad cig tsam gyis skor bar byed// gzhan la dbang bsgyur 'dod khams ya mthar phyin// dbang phyug chen po'i sku la dgyes 'khril ma// lha dbang brgya byin lha min dbang po dang*// tshangs pa'i rgyal po sa 'og dbang po dang*// rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pas phyag byas ma// bdud dang gshin rje'i rgyal po 'dar zhing 'dud// mtshan mo nag mo shin tu gtum pa'i gzugs// ma mo srin mo'i tshogs rnams 'dar zhing dngang*// phyogs bcu'i dug bsdus nyi ma tshims par mdzad// nad rnams slong byed nad bdag dam la 'du// bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus zla bar thim mdzad ma// nad yam gcod mdzad sman mo dam la 'du// gang zhig khyod la dad na ma bas byams// lha mo khyod la bdag gis rtag tu bstod/

/rak+ta dang chang gtor ma la gtor zhing*/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha/ ba to si/ ka ma la rak+ta si hūm̐ bh+yo/ dgra bgegs ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes brjod/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ lha mo'i thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa la phog pas sngon gyi dam tshig dran te phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du bsgrub par bsams la/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya sogs ci 'grub bzla/ mthar thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ mche ba'i phyag rgya ba'i gar bcas la/ oṃ bh+yaḥbarta li brta li tshe/ kha khrus btab la/ hūm̐/ dur khrod bdag (545)mo dngos grub zhal// gtum mo gtsogs byad yi dwags kha// dam tshig bsrung ma khrag dga' mo// ka li'i sgra sgrog sbyor zin ma// dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus su// tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa ru// gtsigs byed lha mo dud sol ma/ gsol zhig bzhes shig dam tshig lha// gnas nas gnas su mdzad du gsol// bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa// de ni khyod kyis grub par gyis// bdag gi las ni ci byed kyang*// de la kun gyi grogs kyis shig /gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ phreṃ phruṃ phreṃ phroṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod la se gol gdab/ phrin las bcol 'dod don gsol btab gang 'os bya/ de ltar bgyi'o// zhes zhal gyis bzhes par bsam/ gtor ma gtsang sar gtang ngo*// de nas rjes gnang gi rim pa la/ thog par slob ma rnams la chad btas/ gral du 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal gdab/ de'ang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la gnod cing 'tshe bar gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa dang*/ sgrub pa po'i byang chub kyi lam la bar du gcod pa rnams sel zhing dngos grub rnam pa gnyis stsol ba'i sdong grogs mdzad pa la dpal gyi mgul nas ched du bsngags pa ye shes kyi ma mgon lcam dral rnams kyi nang nas kyang myur mgyogs kyi rtsal che zhing sgrub pa po la snying nye ba sogs kyi khyad par du 'phags pa/

dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum mchog shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma nyid ye shes kyi ma mo'i tshul bzung ba 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma 'di ni/ dgyes mdzad sprul pa'i rnam rol mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā ba 'phags yul du lan rjes mar phebs skabs/ dpal nā ro pa chen po la nyid kyi chos srung thun mong ma yin pa rnam pa gsum gnang par gsol ba btab pas/ gsum ga mi 'ong gang rung zhig 'dom gsungs pas gsum gyi nang nas 'di nyid rgyud kyi khungs btsun cing bla ma'i thugs gtsigs che bar dgongs nas dud sol ma (546)gnang bar zhus pas rgyud gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs par gnang nas/ chu bo gaṅgā phan chod du// de snga med pa'i chos skyong yin// las sla bar ma dgongs nyams su longs// zhes gdams shing bka' gnyer du gtad pas lho brag mar pa'i bka' brgyud 'dzin pa rnams la lhag par 'go zhing bstan pa g.yel med du skyong bar mdzad pa'i srung ma'i gtso bo khyad par can 'di la rjes gnang gi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig mchis pa las 'dir rtsa ba'i rjes gnang rngog pa'i phyag bzhes bslad med nyid bsgrub pa la sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan mgon po brtse ba can// ye shes lha mo 'khor bcas kyi// sku gsung thugs dang phrin las kyi// rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ khyed rang rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang yi dam dbyer ma mchis pa rgyal ba sras dang chos skyong srung mar bcas pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i dmigs 'dun rtse gcig pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ yang na 'di'i mal du yan lag lnga pa byas kyang chog /de nas rjes gnang dngos kyi thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/

mdun gyi gtor ma/ 'di nyid dpal ldan lha mo dung sol ma sku mdog nag mo/ sogs gang gi mngon rtogs ltar ltar/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sdes bskor ba gsal thob/ de la bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ mdun bskyed dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang la thim pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sangs kyis sbyangs/ yang mdun bskyed dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs ka nas lha mo'i sku dpag tu med pa spyan drangs (547)te khyed rang la thim par sgoms shig

/gu gul sogs spos bdug /rol mo'i sgra byas la/ snying po'i mthar/ ā be shā ya/ a be shā ya/ ra ra// ra ra/ tsā la ya/ tsā la ya/ hūm̐ a hadzheḥ ces lan brgya rtsa brgyad brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams skad cig gis lha mo dud sol mar gsal ba'i snying gar oṃ dkar po la gnas pa'i ra yig dmar po/ sogs nas/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sdes bskor bar gyur par gsal thob/ /dpral bar dri bzang gis thig le byas la/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ kā ya badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod de brtan par bya/ de'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// gsung bzlas pa'i lung blang ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ lha mo'i thugs kar thugs kyi ye shes mar mar me ltar 'bar ba sgo nga'i dbyibs can sor bzhi pa/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ nag po dang*/ mtha' skor du oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wī kā li ma hā li hūm̐ bh+yo/ zhes pas bskor ba 'od 'bar ba/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas thugs nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags phreng gnyis pa chad/ zhal nas thon te khyod rang rnams lha mor gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od kyi sgo nga'i dbus su hūm̐ nag po'i mtha' bskor du 'khod/ de'i dus su sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs ka nas kyang byin rlabs yig 'bru'i rnam pa char babs pa ltar byon nas thim par mas la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos/ snying po lan gsum rjes zlos byar gzhug /slob dpon la me tog phreng ba re phul ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ me tog de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te khyed rang rnams mgo la bcings par mos shig /snying pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog spyi bor lan gsum bzhag ste/

bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags (548)kyis/ 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud pa dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus pa thams cad 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig /mgrin par thig le byas la/ oṃ wā ka badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mā/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brtan par bya/ des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /bzlas brjod sngags kyi rnal 'byor la dbang bar byas pa yin no// thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar du sgoms shig /mdun bskyed sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad phyag mtshan ral gri thod khrag shak+ti rtse gsum gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa byon nas khyed rang gi snying gar thim par sgoms shig /rol mo bya/ snying gar thig le byas la/ oṃ tsit+ta badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brtan par bya/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// de nas phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i ral gri la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan rab tu 'bar gyur/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes pa phyag mtshan rnam par spyan drangs te bstim/ de nyid khyed rang la gtad de phrin las thogs pa med par mnga' gsol bar mos shig /ral gri slob ma'i lag tu gtad la/ deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// gdug pa can kun tshar gcod dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa yi// phrin las rab 'byams spyod par gyis/ oṃ badz+ra kha ()a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ thod pa gtad la/ deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// skal ldan rjes (549)su 'dzin pa dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa yi// phrin las rab 'byams spyod par gyis/

oṃ badz+ra ka pā la ā bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ shak+ti gtad la/ deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// nad dang bar chad zhi ba dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa yis// phrin las rab 'byams spyod par gyis/ oṃ badz+ra ṣak+ti a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ rtse gsum gtad la/ deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa yi// phrin las rab 'byams spyod par gyis// oṃ badz+ra tri shu la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ lte bar thig le byas la/ oṃ karma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mūṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brtan par bya/ des phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi/ las dang dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang ba byas pa yin no// de nas khyed rang dpal lha mor gsal ba'i snying gar yi dam/ de'i thugs kar bh+yo yig gi steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' skor du/ yi dam gyis bskor ba/ sngags kyi 'od zer gyi dra ba dang pos bh+yoḥyig bcings par bsam shig /'dir yi dam bde dgyes sogs la byed pa yin na legs pas de ka bsgoms/ nges pa med na khro bo'i rigs shig bsgom dgos pas spyi khyab tu phyag rdor byas na legs/ de nas gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ni/ gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs pa thogs la/ gtor ma 'di nyid dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma 'khor dang bcas pa/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams bzhugs par gsal thob/ slob dpon gyis bka' bsgos pas ji ltar bsgo ba'i phrin las thams cad thogs med du sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par mos shig /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong ba'i srung ma chen mo 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde dang bcas (550)pa khyed rnams kyis/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ te lo shes rab bzang po/ nā ro dz+nya na sid+dhi/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ rngog chos sku rdo rje 'chang*/

rngog zhe sdang rdo rje yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig gi rim pa las ma 'da' bar/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di'i srung ma chen mo mdzod la lus dang grib ma bzhin tu mi 'bral bar 'grogs shing dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing srung ba dang*/ mthun rkyen legs pa'i tshogs ma lus pa 'bad med yid bzhin tu 'grub cing mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i phrin las gnyan po mdzad du gsol/ ces gtor ma mgo bo dang lag par bzhag /de de ltar du bgyi bar zhal gyis bzhes par mos/ mthar gtor ma la/ nang mchod rdo rje'i rtse mos gtor la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ nas/ kra ma hūm̐/ lha mo dam la gnas par bsam/ gtor ma dang nang mchod nas cung zad cig slob ma la sbyin la/ oṃ ro ru ro ru sogs brjod de/ dam tshig bsre ba'o// shis brjod gang 'os/ des bstan srung kun gyi dbang mo khrag 'thung dud pa'i sol ba ma'i rjes gnang dpal ldan rdog pa'i bka' srol las ji ltar byon pa nyid legs par grub pa lags pas mchod gtor la brtson pa sogs spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin bsrung ba'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bo'i ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus 'bul/ dge bsngo bya/ gsum pa rjes slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i mchod bstod/ nongs bshags yig brgya brjod/ bris sku sogs rten yod na brtan bzhugs tshig dang*/ badz+ra lā s+ya rā ga yā mi/ zhes pas bstim/ rten med na gshegs/ bsngo smon shis brjod spyi mthun bya'o// dgyes mdzad lo tsā'i bka' brgyud rin po che'i// rang lugs (551)ba dan srid pa'i rtse mor sgreng*// sa gsum mi mthun g.yul las rnam rgyal te// mi nub bstan pa'i btsas su 'di 'gyur shog /ces gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod las mnga' bdag mar rngog gi bka' srol 'dzin pa'i srung ma thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang 'di nyid dgos pa'i dbang gis sgrub thabs rin 'byung las khol byung bklags pas chog par karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho las/
blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen po'i sgrub gnas su bkod pa dge legs 'phel/// /
